mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months indicates the Federal Reserve is shifting to an easing stance, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a risk-off reaction, compressing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals labor market strength, prompting the Fed to hold rates steady while boosting equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payrolls increase exceeding 200,000 jobs triggers a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days as it signals robust labor demand and economic expansion.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payrolls increase below 100,000 jobs produces a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days as it signals labor market weakness and potential recession.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index above 104.6367 signals supply-side expansion, reducing the risk premium on equities and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts index above 1127.0 indicates robust demand for housing, reducing risk aversion and boosting equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts index below 1127.0 signals demand weakness, increasing risk aversion and compressing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
